name: CheManager
notes: Live CHEManager trade publication (Wiley-VCH) for the chemical/pharma industry, freely readable with no paywall; e-paper archive accessible and some sponsored downloads registration-gated. Its published Terms and Conditions govern advertising contracts only and say nothing about reuse or reproduction of editorial content; no article-reuse licence is stated anywhere. Record fields (open, proprietary, catalog-only) are accurate. Evidence: https://www.chemanager-online.com and /en/page/terms-and-conditions (read 2026-11-13)
